panels.description:
Burn [0-100%] scales from transparent through gray to white.
SuperBurned subnets are red

targets.rawSql:
WITH burn_values AS (
    SELECT
        sb.meta_epoch_id,
        sb.subnet_id AS netuid,
        CASE
            WHEN sb.superburn >= 0.1 THEN 1.75
            ELSE sb.burn
        END AS value
    FROM metagraph_subnet_burn AS sb
)
SELECT
    blk.timestamp AS "time",
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.netuid = 1 THEN b.value ELSE NULL END) AS "1",
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.netuid = 2 THEN b.value ELSE NULL END) AS "2",

panels.title: Subnet Emissions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    blk.timestamp AS "time",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE se.emission_enabled) AS enabled_count
FROM metagraph_meta_epoch AS me
JOIN metagraph_block AS blk
    ON blk.number = me.block_id
LEFT JOIN metagraph_subnet_emission AS se
    ON se.meta_epoch_id = me.block_id
WHERE blk.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()
  AND blk.timestamp <  $__timeTo()
GROUP BY blk.timestamp
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE se.emission_enabled) > 0
ORDER BY blk.timestamp;
